label: US Equities (Alpaca)
notes: Alpaca keys are trade-only by design; the account status must be ACTIVE and not trading-blocked.
terms_note: Alpaca Trading API with key/secret headers. The adapter points at PAPER trading by default; live trading needs live keys and adapter.base_url https://api.alpaca.markets. place_order and cancel_order act on the configured account.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Alpaca API key id (APCA-API-KEY-ID). Paper keys (paper dashboard) work only on https://paper-api.alpaca.markets, the default here; live keys need adapter.base_url https://api.alpaca.markets.

me.note: Account status (must be ACTIVE), cash, buying_power, equity, trading_blocked.

list_markets.note: Every active US equity in one (large) response; `query` is not sent.

get_ticker.note: Market-data snapshot from data.alpaca.markets (same keys); the default feed is IEX unless the account has a SIP subscription.

get_balances.note: Open positions (holdings per symbol); cash and buying power are in `me`.

list_orders.note: `status` is open (Alpaca's default), closed or all; up to 500 orders.

place_order.note: Places an order on the account behind the configured keys and host: paper trading by default (https://paper-api.alpaca.markets); if adapter.base_url is the live host it PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS. Keep testing on paper and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. Orders are DAY orders; limit orders need `price`, omit it for market orders. Insufficient buying power is answered with HTTP 403 and surfaces as auth_error.

cancel_order.note: Accepted with HTTP 204; an order that is no longer cancelable is rejected with 422.

not_offered.get_candles: Historical bars come from GET /v2/stocks/bars?symbols=, whose response keys bars by symbol ({bars: {AAPL: [...]}}) so the row path depends on the argument, and `start` defaults to the beginning of the current day (the vocabulary carries no time range).

auth: Headers APCA-API-KEY-ID and APCA-API-SECRET-KEY on every request (trading and market data).

endpoints.notes: latestTrade.p, latestQuote.bp/ap, minuteBar, dailyBar, prevDailyBar; feed
symbol, qty, side, market_value, cost_basis, unrealized_pl, avg_entry_price
status open|closed|all (default open), limit (default 50, max 500), symbols
symbol, qty (string) or notional, side, type, time_in_force (day, gtc, opg, cls, ioc, fok), limit_price

reference.limits: 200 requests per minute per account (trading API).

evidence: host paper-api.alpaca.markets: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 7/7 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://docs.alpaca.markets/openapi/trading-api.json, https://docs.alpaca.markets/openapi/market-data-api.json: 7/7 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
